body: Hello, I have had premium with Avicus for quite some time now and just noticed I have not been getting double credits for quite a long time.

title: Credits

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: You should have. Emerald rank gets 2x credits and it works for me. It should say in chat (2x) when you kill someone or gain credits for any reason. To make sure you do get the 2x, a kill is 4 credits for emerald. A monument is 30. Make another thread if what I stated is wrong or if it's still not working.
